ننزعج (form VII)
# نَنْزَعِجُ (nanzaʕiju) /nan.za.ʕi.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# نَنْزَعِجَ (nanzaʕija) /nan.za.ʕi.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# نَنْزَعِجْ (nanzaʕij) /nan.za.ʕid͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
